data.one_liner: Generate image provider from svg path for Flutter Image widgets.
data.what_it_does: Generates a custom ImageProvider from SVG paths, allowing SVGs to be used directly inside standard Flutter Image widgets. It uses flutter_svg and http dependencies under the hood to parse and render SVG assets or network paths.
use_when: You need to pass an SVG as an image provider to widgets that expect ImageProvider.
You want to render SVGs using standard Flutter Image widgets.
avoid_when: You can use flutter_svg directly with SvgPicture widgets instead of an ImageProvider.
You require advanced caching or transformation features provided by other image packages.
strengths: Allows using SVGs anywhere an ImageProvider is accepted.
Supports assets, file system, and network SVG paths.
weaknesses: Relies on external packages like flutter_svg and http.
Limited to what a custom ImageProvider can do compared to dedicated picture widgets.

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides native SvgPicture widgets for rendering SVGs directly without needing a custom image provider.

alternatives.name: vector_graphics
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative graphics library for rendering vector assets efficiently.
